base.input: Original PIL RGB256/ImageNet, FP32, one stone and one fiber forward; both native three-class maps and mask to CPU. No photometric transforms, extra forward/crop, thresholds or mapping changes. Unadopted research base, default A0 unchanged.

arm_definition.raw2: Only frozen raw2 semantic inference; no local observer.
arm_definition.geometry_window: Same bounded seed axes, anchors and two-end search sampling as local_current_evidence; exports current unfiltered in-bounds interior probes and search corridors as GEOMETRIC OPPORTUNITY ONLY, never visible fiber. No RGB evidence classification.
arm_definition.local_current_evidence: Same axes/anchors/windows and interior probe coordinates, plus current RGB bilateral edges, local shaft/background chromaticity contrast, original neural support and internal-transition diagnostics. Exports supported/unknown/conflict candidates; no changes to any visible semantic pixel.

proposal.reuse: Reuse FastFiberObserver.proposals ONLY: 160 grid, P2>=0.2, component>=4, maximum2 axes, mass ranking and native-coordinate PCA. Do NOT call T1.measure/current/state or inherit its5pair/width-ratio/directed-front acceptance. Return all original proposal rejection/ambiguity metadata separately.
proposal.orientation: Search BOTH seed ends independently. FOV distance/orientation is logged as a hint, never decides which end is a true distal tip. No reciprocal width fix, automatic entry flip, or forced winner because at most one physical fiber is present.
proposal.scale: s=min(H,W)/400; all grid-to-native transforms exactly as frozen proposal code. W=proposal.width,L=ends[1]-ends[0]. No GT axis/length/ROI.
proposal.anchor_policy: 21 interior probes per axis. Need>=12 in-bounds points with original native fiberP2>=0.9 AND fiber argmax2 AND raw mask2. Other points are not promoted by geometry. Shaft median current-frame chromaticity uses qualified points only; outside median uses valid side probes, min6. These are ephemeral same-frame contrasts, not trained/shared histogram/template calibration. Missing/ambiguous anchor => original output, explicit reason. Strong neural seed can still be a bright-spot identity error; negative controls are mandatory.

search.extension: E=min(0.20*hypot(H,W),max(2*W,0.5*L)) beyond EACH neural seed end, measured on original image. Engineering bound, not fitted to frame1209; failure to reach reference remains failure.
search.stations: N=min(48,ceil(E/(2*s))+1); linspace(0,E,N), including seed-end station. At most4 end profiles. Log actual step, search-limit censoring, in-bounds/FOV validity and overlapping axes/ends.
search.transverse_halfwidth: 0.75*W+4*s; linspace over symmetric normal range. Geometry only bounds where RGB is inspected, not a taper template to fill/intersect.
search.side_edges: At each normal sample compare original RGB at +/-2*s along normal: norm(deltaRGB)/(255*sqrt(3)). Max eligible negative-normal sample and positive-normal sample independently, deterministic tie nearest expected +/-W/2 then smaller coordinate. Both samples and both +/- probes must be in bounds and original estimated FOV; invalid is unavailable, never a zero-valued edge. Require left<right and BOTH contrasts>=0.04. Width/residual/taper recorded as soft diagnostics, no whole-template acceptance or mask cropping.
search.interior_coordinates: PRIMARY paired population in BOTH nonraw arms is fixed[-0.25,0,0.25]*W relative to the seed axis at each station. geometry_window needs no RGB edge selection. local_current_evidence checks which SAME fixed probes lie inside the independently witnessed side pair, with all out-of-envelope probes unknown. Additional3 between-edge fractions[0.25,0.5,0.75] are SECONDARY diagnostic profiles only, not mixed into primary precision/recall/gates or compared against a different geometric population.
search.no_gap_fill: Scan the bounded window even after unsupported stations so currently visible disconnected pieces may be inspected. Unsupported intervals/occluded/ambiguous pixels remain unknown; no interpolation/fill/reconnection. A later supported section is only a same-axis instance hypothesis, not proof of identity or hidden continuity.
search.stone: Raw stone pixels stay class1 exactly. Candidate evidence that overlaps raw stone is exported as protected_conflict, separately audited; cannot silently suppress conflict opportunity statistics or overwrite stone.

appearance.features: Original RGB/255, normalized RGB chromaticity c=RGB/(R+G+B+1e-6), blue-excess b=cB-0.5*(cR+cG), HSV H/S/V, Lab L/a/b and local inside/outside contrast. Encoded-image features, not physical illumination or a calibrated fiber probability.
appearance.local_comparison: muF=component-wise median chromaticity of qualified current shaft probes; muB=median of valid current anchor side probes. dF=norm(c-muF),dB=norm(c-muB); qC=(dB-dF)/(dB+dF+1e-6). Positive means nearer observed shaft than sampled local background; not necessarily blue or true fiber. No shared fit across images/video, online prototype update, hue threshold or gamma.
appearance.color_reliability: rhoC=clip(norm(muF-muB)/0.10,0,1)*valid_side_fraction. A sampled color with maxRGB<0.03 OR (maxRGB>=0.98 AND saturation<0.10) has unavailable color evidence (rho_pixel=0); it is UNKNOWN, not background. Otherwise rho_pixel=rhoC. Low-saturation/white tip may retain neural/edge evidence; no blue-only veto.
appearance.supported_candidate: Only CURRENT bilateral-supported station AND >=2of3 PRIMARY fixed probes valid and inside witnessed edges, each satisfying either (rho_pixel>=0.5 AND qC>0) OR original fiberP2>=0.1. P2<0.1 is deliberately accessible through reliable local RGB evidence, unlike unchanged T2-P. A supported station flags only its individually supported probes, never the entire interval. Export separate evidence vectors/reasons, no weighted-sum scalar called probability. No anchor or color separation means uncertainty, not auto extension.
appearance.instance_hypothesis: At least2 supported stations strictly beyond a seed end (t>0) needed for a supported axis-group hypothesis. Deduplicate the at-most2 axes using frozen T1 support-ID IoU>=0.8 AND axis difference modulo pi<=5deg; retain original candidates/logs. Multiple distinct qualifying axis groups => ambiguous; two ends of one axis are NOT two instances or a known entry/tip orientation. One group => unambiguous HYPOTHESIS, not confirmed true identity. Count all supported probes, including ambiguous candidates, in quality statistics so ambiguity cannot hide FP.
appearance.internal_transition: Record axial RGB,Lab and original P2 changes at the3 interior profiles. A neural/color drop is NOT a terminal boundary. If bilateral current support exists at>=2 further sampled stations, flag internal_transition_candidate; do not nominate the strongest axial gradient as tip.
appearance.end_status: No asserted anatomical endpoint in this feasibility round. Export side-evidence continuation, axial transitions and search/FOV/occlusion/contrast-limit reasons. Even apparent lateral closure and cross-axis transition are unverified boundary candidates, never geometry-filled cap or fixed expected length. Round/low-contrast caps may remain unknown.

mask_policy: EXACT raw2 masks in all3arms, all classes unchanged. Search corridors, sampled evidence and any rasterized GT-opportunity maps are DIAGNOSTICS, never segmentation or pseudo-labels. No deleted/added TP/FP/FN can be claimed; all semantic deltas must be0.

evaluation.scope: Original29/new41,43/27 cases,68/64 sources,25/107 exposure, per-frame70/132 and originalRGB Lab/HSV bins[0,85,170,256]. Original weights/labels/splits stay frozen.
evaluation.semantic: Same frozen stone/fiber Dice,Precision,Recall,3px boundaryF,semantic skeleton coverage and absolute TP/FP/FN: exact raw2 invariance required. Raw2 still not adopted vs frozen classwise3. No sample evidence score may be substituted for dense semantic accuracy.
evaluation.opportunity: GT use offline only: whole bounded search-corridor coverage of raw FN (including originalP2<0.1, lowLab,insideGT-distance>3*s), negative/nonfiber/stone/unknown area and no-seed/anchor-failed opportunity losses. Geometry-only coverage is an oracle upper scope, never recovered pixels. Output all misses including off-window, seed/direction/color/edge failures.
evaluation.paired_sampling: On EXACT SAME current interior probe coordinates compare all-valid geometric probes against supported RGB/neural subset. GT nearest pixel floor(x+0.5), never bilinear labels; unknown255 excluded, invalid never clamped. Report per-axis/per-end and globally deduplicated native coordinate counts, sampling resolution and denominators. Probe support precision/recall and raw-FN evidence hits are NOT pixel segmentation/tip accuracy; keep fixed-probe and edge-adapted populations separate.
evaluation.negative_controls: All image-dev frames with no GT fiber (reference-defined, including potentially incomplete source labels), original FP/bright spots, raw stone/unknown regions, fixed imageindex16 display17 associated with unreviewed laser_dot, video1display78, video2display1209 and311/439/622/643/1266. No new 144test or TRAIN pixels. T1 false accepted/width-rejected and no-seed examples remain reported. User failure33-113/330-722 kept as qualitative video intervals, not dense event truth.
evaluation.feasibility_go_no_go: Mechanisms/identity/complete replay/invariant semantic masks and runtime required. On globally deduplicated PRIMARY fixed-probe coordinates, with ambiguous-candidate support INCLUDED: supported original-P2<0.1 reference-FN probes>0 on BOTH70and132 AND fixedvideo2display1209; support precision>=0.95 separately on70and132 (engineering evidence target, not validated clinical criterion); no reference-fiber-absent image may produce an unambiguous supported instance HYPOTHESIS. Empty denominators unavailable, not pass. Secondary edge-adapted profiles never enter these gates. Even passing does not authorize pixel edits/adoption; failure retains negative evidence and stops this finite configuration.
evaluation.tip: 12pending D1 tip tasks plus2planned extensions remain no independent confirmed tip truth; tipRecall/Precision/physical endpoint/length/laser metrics null. Current semantic mask supports visible omission only. No renewed whole training-data audit requirement.42of120 random sample incomplete, no whole-video accuracy estimate.

execution.static: 202fresh actual original2net paired-frame inferences shared by3actually run stateless observers. No transformed inputs, no threefold static forward claim. Original native masks/maps exact vs frozen dark-input raw2. Caches may verify only, never replace current observer inputs in cost tests.
execution.state: No temporal/history/shared appearance state. Both videos independent, static image fresh. Validate original RGB and decoded monotonicPTS else declared frame_index/FPS.
execution.timings: Synchronized original2net pipeline+both native3class maps/mask transfer; seed proposal, anchor, bounded geometry/probes, RGB evidence/metadata and direct total p50/p95/max. Full decode/render/audit/export throughput, actual branch/model counts, CPU/GPU peaks. No p95 subtraction.
execution.budget: Extra observer p95<=5ms design target AND direct total p95<=1000/sourceFPS separately for BOTH videos; report max spikes. At most2axes*2ends*48stations*17normal samples, bounded point probes; no full-image gradients, crop neural inference, optical flow or heavy old fitter.
execution.artifacts: Both complete input/raw2/geometry-window/local-evidence diagnostic videos. Distinct legends for search windows, current observed side edges, supported probes,unknown/protected/conflict; no filled ideal fiber silhouette or displayed terminal point. All202 static boards and all rejection logs, paired probes, originalRGB/GT/P2/localcontrast profiles, window opportunity maps NOT predicted masks, source/config/model/input/output hashes and archive.

stop: Finite geometry/current-evidence feasibility only. No parameter sweep, threshold relaxation, gamma/Retinex, new pixel fusion, model training/default adoption, fixed template, forced cap, history propagation or stoneS3. Actual pixel repair would need a NEW frozen plan preserving raw fiber/stone, its uncertainty fallback and all unchanged segmentation/nonregression/TP-loss gates; this protocol does not approve such repair. Training requires separately approved compliant initialization/data/augmentation/supervision/cost/rollback plan.
